newsitem.title: UK: Scottish Power leads UK utilities higher.
newsitem.headline: Scottish Power leads UK utilities higher.

text.p: British utilities shares forged ahead on Thursday, fuelled by a cocktail of bid talk, bullish results from Scottish Hydro-Electric Plc and good buying interest across the sector, dealers said.
They said a possible bid for The Energy Group Plc from PacifiCorp was continuing to buoy other shares in the sector.
Multi-utility Scottish Power led the way, climbing 11p to 388 by 0955 GMT, while Northern Ireland Electricity Plc gained 9-1/2p to 418-1/2 and Southern Electric Plc rose four pence to 435.
The whole sector is doing well," one market-maker said. "There's been a lot of interest, helped by a bit of bid speculation and Scottish Hydro's results."
Scottish Hydro climbed 7-1/2p to 428-1/2 after reporting annual pre-tax profits up 5.3 percent at 205.4 million stg. The company said the current financial year had started well.
Water shares were also generally firmer, with Thames Water Plc up three pence at 677 and Severn Trent Plc up 3-1/2 at 759.
